name: @da/astro-check
//: astro check on TypeScript 6 while the repo compiles with TypeScript 7. `astro check` refuses TS >= 7 (astro/dist/cli/check) and @astrojs/check peers ^5 || ^6, because it drives the classic TS language-service API that the native compiler no longer exports. This workspace exists only so the isolated linker gives @astrojs/check its own TypeScript 6; run.ts calls its checker directly on the repo root, so astro's CLI never looks up the root's TypeScript. Delete it once @astrojs/check (or @astrojs/ts-content-mapper on TS 7.1+) checks .astro files on TS 7.
